Overview

Częstochowa is a city in Silesian with a population of 222,292. Poland’s spiritual capital, home to the iconic Jasna Góra Monastery and the Black Madonna, one of the most important Catholic pilgrimage sites in the world. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
